scope: Fresh original-pixel reinspection of all 79 remaining point-note targets in these four works, with the one authorized restored-letter disclosure preserved. Multiple tight views and independent challenges supersede overly coarse earlier judgments without altering historical reports.
method: Inspect complete source words first, then isolate promising glyphs in exact native crops and nearest-neighbor enlargements. Read above-letter vowels as well as lower points. Interior dageshes need a separate dot; a vowel connected by a narrow ink neck can be read only where its complete form and comparative source glyphs distinguish it from the ordinary letter. No grammar, modern vocalizer, sharpening, OCR reading, missing consonant, word boundary or numbering supplies a correction.
